title: Complementary rPPG-Derived and Lip-Region Frequency Cues for Talking-Face Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.22284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Talking-face (TF) deepfakes are detected unevenly by rPPG-based methods across generators. We study two lightweight visual-only cues, rPPG-derived waveforms extracted by RhythmFormer and lip-region discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients, on the seven TF methods of Celeb-DF++ under a subject-independent protocol. In-domain, lip-region DCT matches or exceeds the rPPG-derived 1D ResNet on every method except SadTalker, and Concat fusion reaches AUC 0.891 against 0.824 and 0.827 for the unimodal baselines. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation the cues split: each transfers clearly better to three held-out methods, and IP-LAP is near chance for both. Concat averages 0.798 but falls below rPPG alone where DCT transfers poorly, so static fusion only partly exploits this complementarity. translated_title: 用于说话人脸深度伪造检测的互补性rPPG衍生线索与唇部区域频率线索
translated_abstract: 基于rPPG的方法在不同生成器产生的说话人脸深度伪造视频上检测表现不均衡。我们在Celeb-DF++的七种说话人脸方法上，采用受试者无关协议，研究了两种轻量级的纯视觉线索：由RhythmFormer提取的rPPG衍生波形和唇部区域离散余弦变换（DCT）系数。在域内评估中，除SadTalker外，唇部区域DCT在所有方法上均达到或超过rPPG衍生的1D ResNet，且Concat融合达到AUC 0.891，而单模态基线分别为0.824和0.827。在留一生成器评估中，两种线索表现分化：各自对三个留出方法的迁移明显更好，而IP-LAP对两者均接近随机水平。Concat平均为0.798，但在DCT迁移较差的情况下低于单独使用rPPG，因此静态融合只能部分利用这种互补性。唇部区域DCT在七种方法中的六种上优于全脸DCT。我们将rPPG衍生信号视为一种经验性线索，并不声称其具有心脏生理意义。
tldr: 该论文发现rPPG衍生波形与唇部区域DCT频率线索在说话人脸深度伪造检测中具有跨生成器的互补性，两者融合可将域内AUC提升至0.891，但静态融合无法完全利用这种互补性。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that rPPG-derived waveforms and lip-region DCT frequency cues are complementary across generators for talking-face deepfake detection, with fusion boosting in-domain AUC to 0.891, though static fusion only partially exploits this complementarity.
